title: A Note on the Early Entry
story: The piano recorder caught Sunday's trio, including the bar where Lewis entered early and pulled the others off the beat. Priya wanted the recording on the club website because visitors rarely heard the group. Lewis asked for a cut. A public file, he said, would present an inadvertent slip as if it were their standard. Priya replied that cutting the bar would damage the integrity of a live evening. Their compromise was precise. The journal would publish the recording with a note calling the bar an early entry, not a feature of the piece. Lewis would approve the wording first. In return, he would not demand a second take weeks later, when the room and the audience could not be reassembled. The recording stayed whole. The note stopped a mistake from being mistaken for an intention.

vocabulary.definition: Done by accident, not on purpose.
The quality of staying whole and honest.
A middle agreement between two proposals.
The exact words chosen for a note.

quiz.question: How would the journal's note describe the early bar?
options: As an early entry, not a feature of the piece
As a new solo written for the website
As a reason to shut the journal
As a studio take made the next week
quiz.correctAnswer: As an early entry, not a feature of the piece
quiz.explanation: The note would call the bar an early entry, not a feature of the piece.
quiz.supportingSentence: The journal would publish the recording with a note calling the bar an early entry, not a feature of the piece.

quiz.question: What did Lewis agree not to demand?
options: A second take weeks later
A written apology from Priya
Removal of the whole slow movement
A replacement piano for the club
quiz.explanation: In return he would not demand a second take weeks later, when the room could not be reassembled.
quiz.supportingSentence: In return, he would not demand a second take weeks later, when the room and the audience could not be reassembled.

quiz.question: What might listeners assume if that note were left off?
options: That Lewis had meant to enter at that point
That the Sunday concert had never happened
That Priya had composed a different piece
That the website would play a single bar
quiz.correctAnswer: That Lewis had meant to enter at that point
quiz.explanation: The note exists so a mistake is not mistaken for an intention.
quiz.supportingSentence: The note stopped a mistake from being mistaken for an intention.

quiz.question: What does integrity mean in Priya's reply?
options: An honest and complete account of the live evening
A faster speed for every movement
A signed contract with the website
The count of people who press play
quiz.correctAnswer: An honest and complete account of the live evening
quiz.explanation: Cutting the bar would damage the integrity of a live evening by hiding what happened.
quiz.supportingSentence: Priya replied that cutting the bar would damage the integrity of a live evening.

quiz.question: Why does the writer say visitors rarely heard the group?
options: To explain why Priya wanted the recording made public
To show the hall had banned every listener
To prove Lewis refused to perform for people
To argue that club journals should avoid music
quiz.correctAnswer: To explain why Priya wanted the recording made public
quiz.explanation: Priya wanted the recording online because visitors rarely heard the group.
quiz.supportingSentence: Priya wanted the recording on the club website because visitors rarely heard the group.
